summary: instant heal that eats a Rejuvenation or Regrowth
text: Instantly heals a target with your active Rejuvenation or Regrowth effect for an amount equal to the full duration of the periodic effect.

text: Increases the damage done or health drained by your Drain Life, Drain Soul, and Wrack spells by 4% per each of your Corruption, Siphon Life, and Bane of Agony effects active on the target, up to a maximum increase of 12%.

pending.name: Wrack
summary: Shadow channel that makes your other damage over time +{3}%
text: Tears the target apart from within for 6 sec, inflicting 60 Shadow damage every 1 sec. While channeling, your Siphon Life, Corruption, and Bane of Agony effects on the target deal their periodic damage 100% faster.
